Proposition
[Pointwise Sobolev estimate] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0017 1. Proposition 2.3\group section-2

Let $g$ be a smooth function on $B_r(x_0)\subset M^n$. Then for $N>n/2$, egin{equation} ag {2.45} g^2(x_0)\le rac{c_3(N)}{\epsilon \, \widetilde{\omega }(H,\epsilon , ar r,x_0)} \left(\int _0^{ ar r} r^{2(N-1)}\, rac{dr}{\mathcal{Q}^H(r)} ight) \sum _{i=0}^N ar r^{2(i-N)}\| abla ^i g\| ^2_{B_{ ar r}(x_0)}. \end{equation}

Proof

Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0017 \sketch Let $\psi $ be essentially as above, but made $C^\infty $. Then

egin{equation} g^2(x_0)\le rac{1}{\widetilde{\omega }(H,\epsilon , ar r,x_0)} \int _{\Omega ^H(\epsilon )}\left|\int _0^{ ar r} rac{d}{dr} igl(\psi g(r, heta ) igr)\, dr ight|^2 d heta \end{equation}

egin{equation} ag {2.46} = rac{1}{\widetilde{\omega }(H,\epsilon , ar r,x_0)} \cdot \int _{\Omega ^H(\epsilon )}\left[\int _0^{ ar r} rac{r^{N-1}}{A^{1/2}(r, heta )} rac{d^N}{dr^N} igl(\psi g(r, heta ) igr)A^{1/2}(r, heta )\, dr ight]^2 d heta \end{equation}

\[ \le rac{c_3(N)}{\epsilon \, \widetilde{\omega }(H,\epsilon , ar r,x_0)} \left(\int _0^{ ar r} rac{r^{2(N-1)}\, dr}{\mathcal{Q}^H(r)} ight) \sum _{i=0}^N ar r^{2(i-N)}\int _{B_{ ar r}(x_0)}\| abla ^i g\| ^2, \]

and the claim follows.

□

Proposition prop:refined-injectivity-angle-lower-estimates gives a lower estimate for $\widetilde{\omega }(H,\epsilon , ar r,x_0)$ for $\epsilon , ar r$ sufficiently small. Combining this with Proposition 24 and Proposition 26 gives get the following result. As in previous instances, the statement can be sharpened somewhat; see Proposition prop:refined-injectivity-angle-lower-estimates(iv).
